transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining the case conference. As you know, a former sales executive left last week and joined a direct competitor. We have reason to believe confidential customer information may have been used after the departure, and we may be looking at a preliminary-injunction hearing within three weeks. Our current draft filing seeks broad relief covering customer information, pricing materials, and source-code documentation. Before I can record any authorization to file, I need each of you to report any material issues in your respective areas. Let's start with employment counsel, then forensics, then insurance. Please go ahead.
